section_summary.extract_value: This introduction highlights the importance of healthy eating and the limited research on caregiver eating messages beyond adolescence, particularly outside the US. It introduces the Caregiver Eating Messages Scale (CEMS) and the Intuitive Eating Scale-2 (IES-2) as key measurement tools. The present study (Study X) aims to examine the psychometric properties of novel Brazilian Portuguese translations of the CEMS and IES-2, emphasizing Brazil as a relevant cultural context due to its unique eating patterns and nutrition transition.
